items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: She used to always speak of Jimmy Noon, you know, in the days when she was playing.

ctx.x: She's the one who used to always be sending cards into Tony Amarico, asking for Lizzie Miles. I think she is. Yeah. We'd give her full name sometime. I'd wonder if that's Wilhelmina Barth that I heard about. She played with Jimmy Noon.
Yeah. She used to always speak of Jimmy Noon, you know, in the days when she was playing. Wilhelmina played with so many during that period and played with so many of those that still play now.
